title: UPDATE: Musk-Funded PAC Deploys Conversational AI Robocalls to Target James Talarico in Texas Senate Race
summary:
A political action committee funded by Elon Musk has begun using conversational AI for robocalls targeting Democrat James Talarico in the Texas U.S. Senate race. The calls, obtained by journalist Emily Killebrew, attack Talarico on issues including the development of AI data centers in the state. In response, Talarico's campaign said that the use of such technology suggests Republican candidate Ken Paxton's only volunteers are "AI robots."

The deployment of AI technology follows a massive financial injection from Musk, whose total spending to bolster Paxton's campaign is approaching $200M. Much of the support arrived through a $158M donation to the Senate Leadership Fund (SLF) in the third quarter, which was immediately transferred to the Texas PAC. The contribution accounted for more than half of the SLF's $273M raised during that period and is part of a broader effort in which Musk has spent up to $369M to support Republican causes in the 2026 midterms.
